# Negative control

This document loads the extension but contains no index marks. Mark-like
text appears only inside code, where it must survive untouched and produce
no index at all.

A fenced code block:

```markdown
[term]{.index}
[term]{.index entry="Custom Entry"}
[]{.index entry="Ghost!Sub"}
```

And inline code: `[term]{.index}` and `[x]{.index entry="Top!Leaf"}`.

Ordinary prose mentioning the word index, a stray brace } and a stray
percent sign %, none of which is a mark.
